title: Cross-functional POC Alignment Sprint — Run Notes & Slide Plan
summary: Working doc for a 3-hour cross-functional POC alignment sprint with a mid-market fintech customer. Purpose: converge on success metrics, deployment constraints, minimal viable integration plan, and a 30-day pilot timeline. Includes slide skeleton, facilitation cues, interactive exercises, and parking-lot items.
prework_customer: Share current API call volume and 95th/99th latency targets (CSV)
List top 3 user flows that will surface LLM outputs (links to product docs or mockups)
Provide security/compliance constraints: egress rules, required encryption, audit requirements
Complete short questionnaire: expected tokens per request, burst patterns, retention policy
prework_internal: Prepare demo dataset (anonymized) and 3 representative prompts
Deploy a lightweight hosted demo model to sandbox and capture perf baseline
Prepare one-slide tech map showing hosting options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
Read customer prework responses and flag open questions before sprint
agenda: 0:00–0:10 — Welcome & outcomes (Marisol) — purpose, success criteria for session, ground rules
0:10–0:30 — Context-setting from customer (Customer PM) — 3 user stories, constraints, timeline
0:30–1:00 — Current-state technical walkthrough (Customer Architect + Ethan) — infra, auth, data flows
1:00–1:25 — Live demo + perf baseline (internal sandbox) — show 3 sample prompts and latency/cost numbers
1:35–2:00 — Interactive mapping: match user flows to integration patterns (breakout groups)
2:00–2:25 — Risk brainstorm & mitigation mapping (whiteboard) — compliance, scale, quality
2:25–2:45 — Draft pilot plan: MVP surface, metrics, gating criteria (Priya to lead)
2:45–3:00 — Actions, owners, and next steps; close (Marisol)
slide_outline: Slide 1 — Title: Cross-functional POC Alignment Sprint
Slide 2 — Session goals & desired outcomes (bullets: alignment on MVP, deployment path, 30-day pilot plan)
Slide 3 — Customer context: problem statement + top user journeys
Slide 4 — Non-functional constraints: latency SLOs, compliance needs, hosting restrictions
Slide 5 — Proposed integration patterns (diagram): direct API, sidecar, async job
Slide 6 — Performance baseline: sandbox numbers (p50/p95/p99, tokens, cost estimates)
Slide 7 — Quality & evaluation plan: prompt set, eval rubric, regression alerting
Slide 10 — Success criteria and acceptance tests
Slide 12 — Appendix: config knobs to tune (batching, kv-cache, quantization profile)
Speaker notes: call out where to solicit customer input, where to demo live metrics, and where to capture decisions
facilitation_notes: Opening: set explicit expectations — this is decision-oriented not a status update
Timebox strictly — call out time remaining at 5 and 2 minutes
During demo: narrate what the numbers mean for cost and UX tradeoffs (eg 100ms vs 500ms)
Breakouts: each group assigns a scribe and a presenter; use the shared drive whiteboard file
Use the 'Red, Yellow, Green' shorthand when capturing risks; translate to mitigation owner ASAP
When disagreements appear, map to hypothesis + experiment rather than a design fight (convert to a canary test)
Record decisions in the session doc with an explicit owner and date for follow-up
Encourage ops/security to speak up early about network requirements — treat as blocking if unclear
interactive_exercises: Integration mapping (10 min): draw the simplest integration path that meets the latency SLO
Quality tradeoff matrix (10 min): pick 3 prompts and rate tolerance for hallucination vs brevity
Pilot backlog prioritization (15 min): vote on candidate MVP features using dot-vote
Deployment cutover simulation (5 min): walk through traffic switch and rollback plan
success_criteria: Signed alignment on a single MVP surface and 3 measurable metrics (latency, cost per 1k tokens, user satisfaction proxy)
Agreement on hosting mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private) with top 3 integration tasks and owners
Security team confirms no unresolved blockers or creates a tracked mitigation
Pilot timeline with dates for demo, metrics review, and go/no-go gate
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Customer requires strict on-prem data residency — Mitigation: map Private deployment prerequisites and estimate lead time
Risk: Burst traffic > current capacity — Mitigation: propose autoscale burst config and fallback model variant
Risk: High regression risk for critical prompts — Mitigation: add a pre-deploy eval suite and daily quality alerts
Risk: Unknown egress rules from customer VPC — Mitigation: engage SRE to run connectivity checklist in first week
parking_lot: Legal review of data processing addendum (DPA)
Cost model for 99th percentile daily traffic (detailed spreadsheet)
Deep-dive on tokenization differences for customer's multilingual inputs
Request for a post-POC performance run with 1000 concurrent simulated users
notes_to_self: Bring 1 pager on quantization tradeoffs — customers often ask during risk session
Prep fallback demo using smaller model variant so we can show graceful degradation
Remember to confirm timezone and dial-in for customer SRE (they're in CET)
Capture exact versions of models used in demo for reproducibility
